_instructions: CRITICAL: Do not leak task administration terms (e.g., 'unit', 'jrn', 'package', 'coverage', 'execution') into product code names, variables, paths, or features.

evidenceIndex.claim: Current user instruction is rank 1; plans under plans/diagnose-implementing are DERIVED_SUPPORT and cannot override canonical product, runtime or repository truth.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Authority classification only; does not prove implementation behavior.

evidenceIndex.claim: Canonical capability truth requires one WLT financial owner, one internal wallet per actor, authoritative Cash-In evidence, server-owned PaymentAllocation, atomic captain COD, verified official-wallet destinations, governed manual external settlement, immutable batches, reconciliation and close gates across all five product surfaces.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Contract is in DISCOVERY; implementation acceptance still requires evidence.

evidenceIndex.claim: Detailed target design consolidates Cash-In, internal wallet truth, captain COD, manual external official-wallet settlements, audit evidence, reconciliation and finance close under WLT.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Service architecture is a design artifact subordinate to canonical governance and current code.

evidenceIndex.claim: WLT already has a single idempotent double-entry posting path with operator-context isolation, but ledger account classification currently recognizes limited asset/income types and defaults all other non-wallet types to liability.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static code evidence; database data and runtime behavior were not executed.

evidenceIndex.claim: Payment sessions have useful concurrency claims and provider_result_unknown handling, but the external mutation edge still uses transport-oriented POST calls and hard-coded /financial/card/authorize and /financial/card/capture paths.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static code evidence only; provider simulator/runtime not executed.

evidenceIndex.claim: Current COD model persists pending_collection -> collected -> remitted custody semantics and supports captain/store-courier/partner-store collectors, which conflicts with the canonical captain-funded COD rule if applied to the same captain order value.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Does not decide alternate non-captain custody semantics; those require their own canonical product truth before retention as active money movement.

evidenceIndex.claim: Current payout destination model still carries bank/mobile_money/manual preferences, bank account/IBAN fields and provider submission behavior, conflicting with the current official-wallet-destination plus manual-external-execution model.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static code evidence; existing persisted rows require forward migration and compatibility analysis before retirement.

evidenceIndex.claim: Settlement code already contains evidence/governed-source/idempotent-policy primitives and operator-context tests that should be reused and extended rather than replaced wholesale.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Directory and selected source inventory only; full runtime lifecycle was not executed.

evidenceIndex.claim: Finance UI still exposes provider-managed payout states/actions such as provider_pending, processing, provider_result_unknown, send-to-provider and provider inquiry, so presentation is materially inconsistent with the current manual external settlement truth.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static UI evidence; browser behavior and authorization rendering were not visually tested.

evidenceIndex.claim: Shared WLT/DSH frontend already contains actor-wallet, commissions, field-finance, finance-boundary, finance and payment modules, providing reusable cross-surface adapters rather than requiring surface-local financial implementations.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Tree inventory does not prove every consumer is correctly bound or free of local calculations.

evidenceIndex.claim: The canonical WLT control-panel route is /wlt/finance with ledger, payment-session and COD inspectors; DSH route inventory also contains operations, partners and support areas that may consume financial projections while catalog/marketing/login routes have no direct finance route identity.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Bounded route inventory only; reopen exclusions if imports or runtime links prove a financial dependency.

evidenceIndex.claim: Repository provides WLT tests/build/lint/OpenAPI guards, financial-boundary guards, control-panel typecheck/build/test, runtime WLT and financial simulator smoke commands, and affected Nx verification commands suitable for candidate-bound verification.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Commands were discovered but not executed in GitHub Remote.

evidenceIndex.claim: Provider layer already separates mock/production support, circuit breaking and inquiry helpers, but remains payment-transport oriented and includes payout inquiry concepts that must not imply automated production cash-out capability.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Real provider contract, credentials, sandbox and production capabilities are external dependencies and were not available.
